text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Mmm, that was delicious. Nothing<n>beats bananas
when it comes to<n>caloric efficiency.

text_block_list.name: Students
text_block_list.text:
Well, well! If it isn't the Banana<n>Fiend! Haha! Looks
like she just had<n>another one.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Banana Fiend? I hope they're not<n>talking about—

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Banana Fiend! Getting that<n>potassium fix of
yours?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: E-excuse you! I'm not even sure I<n>know you!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Banana Fiend... How dare they call<n>me that!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: So that's what happened in my<n>dream...
choice_data_list: You like bananas so much, you dream about them?
You like bananas so much, you dream about them?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
N-no! It may be true that I eat a large<n>number of
bananas, but it's not only<n>because of taste!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
They provide energy to the brain, are<n>portable, and
their sweetness helps<n>reduce fatigue! It's only
logical that I<n>would—

text_block_list.name: Vendor
text_block_list.text:
Welcome! We're having a sale on<n>bananas today!
Come get your fill!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: They're having a banana sale?!
Stomach growls...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Ugh... Is this really my fate? Can Itruly not escape... the temptation?!
choice_data_list: C'mon, snap out of it, Banana Fiend.
C'mon, snap out of it, Banana Fiend.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Ugh... Is this really my fate? Can Itruly not escape... the temptation?!
choice_data_list: C'mon, snap out of it, Banana Fiend.
C'mon, snap out of it, Banana Fiend.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: I thought I told you to quit calling me<n>that!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Gasp!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Sorry about that... And thank you. I<n>nearly
succumbed to it...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, let's leave before my<n>nightmare becomes
a reality.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Why, it all makes sense now!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
My stomach's growling isn't an<n>indication of my
gluttony but a signal<n>from my brain to supplement
my<n>body's nutritional deficiencies!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: In that case, I have no choice but to<n>eat up!

She eats like a true champion. Seeing<n>her devour
that many bananas almost<n>makes me want to call
her "Banana<n>Fiend" too.
